questions.answer: It was important to me what the prrevious students had said about the destination and what the general reputation/vibe of the destination was

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Very easy, my international guidance counsellor (named removed by UCPH) was super helpful in giving me all the information i needed before arriving and upon arrival

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: my int. guidance counsellor had already set up a meeting on my first day where she introduced me to everything. she had also already spoken to all the hospitals and they were all fully prepared for my arrival.
